_comment: Phase 1 corpus sources - primary/authoritative only. Every entry's license_note is copied onto each chunk so the model can disclaim correctly. robots.txt checked 2026-09-01: law.go.kr 'Allow: /'; elaw.klri.re.kr blocks only search/admin endpoints (viewer.do is allowed); eps.go.kr 'Allow: /'. robots.txt checked 2026-09-02 (Phase 3 gap-fill): easylaw.go.kr 'Allow: /'.
_known_gap: Korean-language originals are not yet ingested - law.go.kr Korean pages are JS-rendered and returned only a shell. Retrieval is English-side by design (see plan), so this is deferred, not blocking. Korean official terms are handled via a Phase 3 glossary instead.
